title: Add a new release repository for unitree_ros
author: PedroS235
body:
* Name of the release team: snt-arg

* Release repositories to add:
  * [unitree_ros](https://github.com/snt-arg/unitree_ros)
    * I have created a [PR](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/39857#issuecomment-1934281070) on rosdistro. Waiting it to be merged.

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
> * Waiting it to be merged.

Projects must be merged in rosdistro before release repositories are created.

comments.author: PedroS235
comments.body:
Hey @nuclearsandwich,

Thanks for reviewing the issue. 
I am currently stuck due to license restrictions to add the repo to rosdistro. I am in the process to change to a license that fits rosdistro requirements, thus it will take some time for me to change it. 

Would it be fine for this issue to be opened until it gets uploaded to rosdistro?

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
> Would it be fine for this issue to be opened until it gets uploaded to rosdistro?

Yep, this issue can remain parked until the upstream PR is resolved which I see could be shortly.

comments.author: PedroS235
comments.body:
